newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, new losses for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, new losses for blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed, with some blue chips extending their losses and drugs firm Pliva staying out of the market for the first time in months.
* Five of 12 active issues rose, four fell and three were flat.
* Volume fell to 4,253 from 6,858 shares, turnover slightly higher at 2.6 million kuna.
* Top gainer electric manufacturer Koncar rose 145 kuna to 1,300, selling 31 shares.
* Top decliner textile firm Varteks edged down 9 kuna to 71, with 100 shares changing hands.
* Most active food processor Podravka inched up four kuna to 295 on volume of 1,691 units.
